lines: See: Tips for running from the Song Library

This song is just like name-that-note, but it uses "placed single note" as the ArpeggioPlugin type: /fpat placed single By default, it has SingleNotes placed at the Nut, 5th, 7th, and 12th frets, since in P4 this gives the fourth, the fifth, and the octave. To change the name-that-note excercise to just exact note positions, turn off HIDE Single Notes, then place SingleNotes you want to practice, then turn HIDE Single Notes back on.

Also on by default is /fpan named which shows all matching NamedNotes on the neck in the current range upon reveal, and /fpa extra clear beat which gives you an extra beat to admire the revealed notes before clearing and showing the next prompt highlight.
Default is P4, positions [0,12], and Transposition off.  Use the links below to set other Tunings, Positions, and Transpositions.
<caption>Click the links to set the Position:</caption>
